tool.name: CpG Harmonisation Stage 3: ComBat Batch Correction
tool.description: Empirical Bayes batch correction using cohort/array-of-origin as batch covariate (sva::ComBat)

configfiles.configfile:
require('minfi', quietly = TRUE) require('sva', quietly = TRUE) options(warn = -1)
load('$grset_in') if (!exists('GRSet')) { stop("grset_in .rda must contain an object named 'GRSet'") }
pheno <- read.table('$phenotype_table', header = TRUE, sep = '\t', check.names = FALSE)
batch <- pheno[['$batch_column']]
#if str($covariate_column) != 'none' mod <- model.matrix(~ pheno[['$covariate_column']]) #else mod <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = pheno) #end if
betas <- getBeta(GRSet) betas.combat <- ComBat(dat = betas, batch = batch, mod = mod, par.prior = TRUE) #Empirical Bayes batch correction betas.combat[betas.combat < 0] <- 0.0001 #ComBat can push values slightly outside [0,1]; clamp back into beta range betas.combat[betas.combat > 1] <- 0.9999
assay(GRSet, 'Beta') <- betas.combat
pca <- prcomp(t(na.omit(betas.combat))) batch.factor <- as.factor(batch) png('$pcapng') plot(pca\$x[,1], pca\$x[,2], col = batch.factor, pch = 19, xlab = 'PC1', ylab = 'PC2', main = 'Post-ComBat PCA, coloured by batch') legend('topright', legend = levels(batch.factor), col = seq_along(levels(batch.factor)), pch = 19) dev.off()
save(GRSet, file = '$grset_out')

param.name: grset_in
param.label: Stage 2 GenomicRatioSet
param.help: Must contain an object named GRSet - the Stage 2 (betaqn cross-platform normalisation) output.

param.name: phenotype_table
param.label: Phenotype / Batch Table
param.help: Tab-separated table with a header row, one row per sample, matching the sample order of the GenomicRatioSet. Must include the batch column named below.

param.name: batch_column
param.label: Batch Column Name
param.help: Name of the column in the phenotype table identifying batch/cohort/array-of-origin, passed to ComBat as the batch covariate.

param.name: covariate_column
param.label: Covariate Column Name (optional)
param.help: Name of a column to preserve as a biological covariate in the ComBat model (e.g. phenotype/disease status), or "none" to correct for batch only.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Stage 3 of the cross-array (450K/EPIC) harmonisation pipeline. Takes the betaqn-normalised ``GenomicRatioSet`` from Stage 2 and applies ``sva::ComBat`` empirical Bayes batch correction, using cohort/array-of-origin (or another user-specified column) as the batch covariate. An optional biological covariate column can be preserved in the correction model so that batch effects are removed without erasing the signal of interest.
***Inputs***
*Stage 2 GenomicRatioSet*: ``.rda`` output of the cross-platform quantile normalisation stage.
*Phenotype / Batch Table*: tab-separated table with a header row, one row per sample, matching the sample order of the GenomicRatioSet. Must include a batch/cohort column.
***Outputs***
*Stage 3 GenomicRatioSet*: an ``.rda`` file containing the batch-corrected ``GRSet``, consumed by Stage 4 (restriction to common probes).
*PCA Plot*: principal component analysis of the batch-corrected beta matrix, coloured by batch, useful for visually confirming batch effects have been removed.
